explanation: Hisaishi first worked with Miyazaki on Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind in 1984. His stage name is a tribute to the American producer and composer Quincy Jones.

claims.text: Joe Hisaishi composed the scores for Hayao Miyazaki's Princess Mononoke (1997) and Spirited Away (2001).
Ryuichi Sakamoto, Toru Takemitsu and Yoko Kanno did not score Princess Mononoke or Spirited Away.
Hisaishi's first film with Miyazaki was Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind (1984).
Joe Hisaishi's stage name was inspired by Quincy Jones.
